name: operator-analytics-telemetry-off
notes: Fresh install with CIVICCAST_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_KEY and _ALLOWED_ORIGINS unset. Toolbar visible and the box 'Audience telemetry is off' under it. Token: support_admin or publish_operator (first-admin token has both).

name: operator-reports-shows
notes: Shows tab (default) with From / Through / Channel filters and the empty-state sentence 'No air times in the selected range...'. Token must carry support_admin.

name: operator-epg-form
notes: Empty state: 'Create export config' form on top, 'No guide exports set up yet.' below. Token: setup_admin or publish_operator.

name: operator-underwriting-spots
notes: Spots tab (default for a manager role). 'Create spot' form fully visible including the 47 CFR 73.503 reminder text and the attestation checkbox; list shows 'No underwriting spots yet.'

name: operator-appadmin-empty
notes: Setup admin, no builds. Build profile filled, New build form showing 'Select a platform...' and 'Select a tier...', 'No builds yet.', 'No submissions tracked yet.'

name: operator-paywall-off
notes: Fresh station: Config card with the blue 'Paywall is OFF' banner; Tiers and Comp access grants cards greyed. Do not enter any Stripe values.

name: operator-readiness-top
notes: Top of the Readiness page after the report has loaded: 'Safe to broadcast' heading, 'On air right now' banner, the report card with 'Check broadcast readiness' button and 'Open resident preview' link. Any colour state is acceptable; note which one was captured.

name: operator-alerts-empty
notes: Healthy station: Active/Resolved buttons, 'No active alerts...' message, Alert rules cards, 'Where alerts go' with 'No alert destinations yet...' and the 'Add destination' button. Setup admin token.

name: operator-eas-empty
notes: Fresh station: posture banner 'Public-safety display - not an EAS device', Channel picker, 'No alert sources are configured yet...', 'No active alerts.', 'Nothing is being displayed.'

name: operator-federation-off
notes: Default state: 'Federation is off' card with the green 'Default-safe' tag, the explanation paragraph, 'Read more in the manual' link and 'Generate station key' button.
